chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who pledges his bondwoman as collateral: is it permissible for him to have intercourse with her? He said: “Those who have taken her as collateral stand between him and her.”
I said: “What if he is able to reach her in private, and those who have taken her as collateral do not know?” He said: “Yes, I do not see any harm in this.”

key_terms.يَحُولُونَ: they prevent or stand in the way
key_terms.يَرْهَنُ: to pledge or place as collateral

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to have intercourse with his bondwoman after pledging her as collateral?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a legal ruling concerning a bondwoman who has been pledged as collateral in rahn. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that the mortgagees restrict the owner's access to her, yet if he is able to be alone with her without their knowledge, he does not see any harm in it.
